label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y hizo el atrio; al lado de Negev, al Temán, colgaduras del atrio de lino fino retorcido, cien en el codo.
spanish: Y hizo el atrio; al lado del sur, hacia el sur, colgaduras del atrio de lino retorcido, cien en el codo.
grammarChanges: Replaced the proper name Negev with the common noun sur, since H5045 is a common noun for south/region, not the place name.
Replaced the proper name al Temán with the directional common-noun phrase hacia el sur, since H8486 carries a directional suffix (southward), not the place name.
Dropped the added qualifier fino from lino fino, since lemma 8336 b with cardinal feminine singular morph leaves the sense open; fino supplied an unlicensed fineness.
